symptom: QUAL004 "Microflow 'Rows' is not called from anywhere. Remove if unused" for the datasource microflow of a Data grid 2 (or gallery) that also has an `onClick: call microflow …`; `show callers of` the datasource microflow reports none. The on-click microflow is fine — whichever of the two sorts first survives
cause: `scanWidgetOwnRefs` collected every Microflow/Nanoflow/Entity/Form value in the widget's own BSON but returned only the lexicographically smallest of each, and the refs table is a SQL projection of that single widgets_data column. Its comment claimed page-level dedup made the per-widget choice immaterial — true only when another widget on the page happens to name the dropped one
insight: Third instance of the widget-ref class after #773 (`Form` not collected) and #940 (templates absorbed): a single-valued column feeding a many-valued graph loses edges silently. Keep the single column for `show widgets` / Starlark `microflow_ref` back-compat (documented as one name, the smallest) and emit the rest from the Builder, deduped with INSERT … WHERE NOT EXISTS so the one-edge-per-page shape holds. Kept RefKind `action` for a datasource microflow: `datasource` would satisfy QUAL004 but is not in `show callers`' callerRefKinds. When re-measuring with `mxcli lint`, the catalog cache is keyed on the .mpr mtime, not the mxcli build — a catalog built by the unfixed binary is reused by the fixed one, so `refresh catalog full force` first or the fix looks ineffective.
